description:
The last measured figure, 43.5% of statements on 2026-08-16, predates the cut and is meaningless — two thirds of both app/ and tests/ are gone.

Run composer test:coverage:clover (about 7 minutes). Do not combine it with TIA: a replay-measured percentage reports whatever TIA chose to re-execute, not a property of the codebase. Record the new baseline in CLAUDE.md, replacing the stale number.
title: Re-measure coverage post-cut
